title: Junior doctors’ nationwide sickout over compensation
reason: Excluded from the event set because the source describes a sickout/work stoppage and facility staffing turnouts, not a public gathering. Regional percentages and 100% no-show rates are workplace staffing indicators, not protest crowd counts. No street assembly, picket, or meeting is established.
notes: Demand was directed to the Government over compensation, but a state target alone does not satisfy the public-gathering and 50-person criteria.

title: Gleaner Company workers protest delayed wage payments
reason: Excluded on current evidence because the demonstrated demand concerned the private media employer’s delayed salary increases and retroactive payments. The report does not describe a demand directed to the Jamaican state or state policy.
notes: A public demonstration is reported, but attendee number is not stated and the employer’s ownership/media role does not make the claim a state target.
